'''XS3''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]].

==Biography==
Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], XS3 was dispatched to the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] along with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Ferreges]] to [[Death/Legends|assassinate]] [[Hanos Darr]] and [[Zaz Kamiroz]], two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents who worked as [[Miner/Legends|miners]] in [[the Graveyard]], the remains of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The two were passing on information to the Alliance concerning the discovery of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace of Alderaan]] in the debris field, unaware it was part of a [[Operation Yavin Kill Two|trap]] set by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] for the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]. XS3 succeeded in killing Darr, but was destroyed in turn by Alliance agents.
